text.tspan: Coherent m=4–m=8 mixing creates the standing-field escape valley
Direct decomposition of Ψ at r = 8 mm · matched leading m = 4 pseudopotential · h35 N48 coefficients
m=4 and m=8 self terms match; their rotating cross term is zero to 1.7×10⁻¹² eV, while the standing term spans ±7.375 eV.
